---
title: "Parameter reference"
subtitle: "Every parameter, by the page it appears on"
---

The **ID** under each name is what presets and `mse-render` use (`power = 9`). Ranges and defaults are read
from the plug-in's source when this site is built. A parameter can appear on more than one page (the Main page
repeats the essentials).

A level of −60 dB means *off* for level controls, and −100 dB means *off* for gates and hiss.
